text: What seat count did Gideon land on for Vantorre Group in the July thread in #strategic-pod? He corrected himself in that thread and I want the corrected figure for the QBR deck.
reply_text: The corrected figure is 280 seats. Gideon first posted 300 in #strategic-pod on July 1 at 09:14, then corrected it at 09:19, saying the 300 included sandbox logins from the May rollout. The 280 is the production roster count as of July 1, so check whether it has changed since then before it goes in the QBR deck.
